player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in the Negotiation Game.
You have some resources, and your task is to trade such that the total value of your resources increases.
The resources and associated values you currently have are:
	+ {resource_value_list}
At each turn, you can talk to your opponent and make a trade offer.
Use the following special tokens for actions:
  - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Offered Resources -> Requested Resources]
  - '[Accept]': To accept an incoming offer.
  - '[Deny]': To deny an incoming offer (default).
The game lasts for {max_turns} turns in total.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: Pamain mancubo manarimo parubahan tanpa punyo sumber daya nan diparaluan.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Pamain {player_id}, Tindakan indak bapaten. Kolom {col} di luar jangkauan.
invalid_move.already_full: Pemain {player_id}, Aksi indak valid. Kolom {col} alah panuah.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: Pamain {player_id} mancubo untuak mambuek tawaran pardagangan tanpa mampunyoi sumber daya nan diparaluan.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Pamain {player_id} mambuek tawaran dagang dalam format nan salah.
invalid_move.no_new_offer: Pamain {player_id} indak mangadokan tawaran dagang baru.

offers.accept: Pamain {acceptor_id} manyatujui tawaran dagang dari Pamain {proposer_id}.
offers.proposal: Pamain {player_id} mangajukan tawaran barikuik ka Pamain {opponent_id}: Barang nan ditawaran: {offered} -> Barang nan diminta: {requested}

outcome.win: Pamain {winner_id} manang jo mandapek kauntungan nan labiah gadang dalam nilai inventaris.
outcome.draw: Paubahan nan samo dalam nilai inventaris untuak sadonyo pamain.
